text:
mark: Quick heads-up — Praxis Health RFI landed. They want a filled capability matrix + security questionnaire back by EOD Friday. Also asking for a POC plan and ballpark pricing for a 3-month pilot. Who can own?
jen: I can own the pricing + SOW draft. Need guidance on burst capacity pricing tiers.
samir: I can run the POC plan + perf tests. When do we need the env?
mark: Thanks. Security Qs are pretty heavy — they asked about KMS/HSM, key custody, and SOC/FedRAMP posture. Ellie, can you handle the security responses or loop in SecOps?
ellie: I can do the security writeup but need specifics on our Private offering (VPC peering, HSM options) and a short note on audit logs retention. Also need sample network diagram.
sec-bot: Reminder: attach the latest security-compliance-pack (v3.1) from /inc/sec/packs. Last updated 2025-01-12.
jen: For pricing, what's the typical Dedicated commit we propose for a health customer with steady 200 req/s? Need CPU/GPU breakdown for the quote.
samir: For the POC, I'd like a dedicated burst pool for baseline perf. Can we get 2x a100 equivalent for 2 weeks? Also need synthetic dataset and a 5k prompt test set.
ellie: Praxis requires BYOK for PHI workloads. We support customer-managed keys via KMS (AWS/GCP) and HSM for Private. I'll note the enrollment steps.
mark: I'll pull legal/ISV clause questions. Also flag: Praxis wants quantized model support (4-bit) and latency SLOs. Product says 4-bit is in evaluation for some models but not GA.
jen: Ok — for pricing, I'll provide 2 scenarios: hosted + overage, and Dedicated reserve with burst. Draft numbers by tomorrow AM.
samir: Perf test plan (quick sketch):
```
- 2 nodes (a100) dedicated
- 5k synthetic prompts, seq_len=512
- measure p50/p95 token latency and throughput
- run 3 iterations staggered over 24h
```
Can ops provision this by Wed?
ellie: I'll attach the KMS/HSM checklist and a short network diagram. Anyone have a sample VPC peering template?
mark: Ops can provision; I'll ping eng-infra for a slot. @samir — I'll book a 1-hr runbook call tomorrow 10am PT.
samir: Perfect. Also: need to confirm model fallback policy. If the quantized variant fails quality checks, we should have an auto-fallback to the float model. Ellie — can we include that in security/ops notes?
ellie: Yes, include fallback policy + audit trail requirement. Will add a short paragraph: "fallbacks logged with model version, request id, and reason".
jen: For the RFI capability matrix rows I need clarifications: model version pinning, canary rollouts, token-level billing export, and embeddings throughput. Anyone have exact wording for pinning?
samir: Pinning = customers can set a model version tag and route all traffic to it until changed. We support canary % routing in Redwood Console. I'll add bullets.
mark: Blocker to call out: we do not currently support on-prem HSM with the hosted API. We can do HSM for Private on customer infra but need to set expectations.
ellie: Noted. I'll be explicit: "On-prem HSM supported in Private deployments only; hosted API supports KMS-based BYOK."
jen: I'll compile the capability matrix + pricing + SOW and upload to Drive by 9am tomorrow. Link will go into the RFI packet.
mark: Action items recap: Jen = pricing + packet, Ellie = security answers + network diag, Samir = POC perf plan + runbook, Mark = legal + infra booking. sec-bot: send compliance pack link in thread when ready.
sec-bot: Compliance pack link: https://drive.redwood/compliance/packs/security-compliance-v3.1.zip
jen: Noted. One more ask — Praxis requested an appendix: tokenized cost model example for a 1M token/month workload. Anyone have a spreadsheet template?
samir: I have a template. I'll drop a sanitized CSV into the drive.
ellie: I'll also add the minimal data handling steps for PHI and redaction recommendations.
mark: Great. If there are any feature gaps Praxis calls out in the RFI, escalate to prod@redwood so we can decide if a timeline/commit is possible. Otherwise aim to deliver the packet Friday morning.
jen: Will do. Thanks team.
mark: Closing — I'll run the 10am runbook invite and make sure eng-infra has the provisioning ticket. Ping here for any blockers. :thumbsup:
